name: What are common signs that my kitchen faucet needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my kitchen faucet needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs include persistent leaks, rust or corrosion around the base or handles, low water pressure specific to the faucet, and physical damage like cracks or chips. Frequent repairs or a desire to upgrade to a more modern, efficient model are also good reasons. Consider the age of your faucet; most faucets have a lifespan of 10-15 years, and older models may not be repairable with easily available parts, making replacement a more cost-effective solution in the long run.
acceptedAnswer.description: Persistent leaks, rust, low water pressure, or physical damage often indicate a need for kitchen faucet replacement. Older faucets may be difficult to repair, making replacement a practical choice.
